existing_to_reuse: Existing telemetry/metrics emitters and dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana or equivalent)
Existing structured logging + log aggregation pipeline
Existing OpenTelemetry trace instrumentation, if present
Existing experiment/feature-flag framework for preprod gating
Existing auth/RBAC for read-only observatory access
Existing event bus / message queue for sensor signal ingestion
Existing schema registry and data catalog if any
Existing retention/lifecycle policies for telemetry data
gaps: No unified sensor registry with ownership, calibration state, and versioning
No measurement governance layer (metric definitions, owners, approval states)
No end-to-end data lineage from sensor emission to derived metric
No ground-truth acquisition planner (sampling, labeling, coverage planning)
No unknown-unknown hunter (anomaly surfacing beyond known dashboards)
No effectiveness observatory tying forward outcomes to interventions
No UX observatory for interaction-level signal capture (consented, preprod)
No calibration lifecycle (drift detection, recalibration scheduling)
No contract tests binding sensors to metric definitions
contracts: SensorDescriptor v1: {id, owner, version, unit, cadence, calibration_ref, schema_ref}
MetricDefinition v1: {metric_id, owner, formula_ref, unit, lineage_ref, integrity_ref, approval_state}
CalibrationRecord v1: {sensor_id, timestamp, method, params, drift_delta, next_due}
LineageEdge v1: {source_id, target_id, transform_ref, ts, hash}
IntegrityAttestation v1: {metric_id, window, checksum, computed_at, verifier}
GroundTruthPlan v1: {plan_id, hypothesis_ref, sampling_strategy, coverage_targets, labels_ref}
AnomalyCandidate v1: {id, detector_ref, signal_ref, score, first_seen, triage_state}
EffectivenessReport v1: {report_id, metric_refs, baseline_window, compare_window, delta, confidence}
UxSignalEvent v1: {session_ref (hashed), event_type, route_ref, dwell_ms, consent_flag}
ReadOnlyObservatoryAPI v1: all endpoints GET-only, POST returns 405 in preprod observatory namespace

implementation_batches.notes: Stand up SensorRegistry and MetricDefinition stores; add contract tests; reuse schema registry if present.
Add CalibrationRecord store, drift detector wrapper, scheduling; read-only UI.
Instrument emitters to publish LineageEdge records; wrapper around existing emitters, no rewrite.
Checksum/attestation service over metric windows; verifier hook + alert.
Plan objects + coverage computation from existing signal catalog; read-only reporting.
Detector ensemble over existing signals; emits AnomalyCandidate only; no auto-action.
EffectivenessReport generator and consented UX signal capture behind preprod flag.
Approval workflow for metrics, distillation targets, runbooks, docs.

tests: Contract tests for all v1 schemas (SensorDescriptor, MetricDefinition, etc.)
Lineage completeness test: every derived metric traces to ≥1 sensor edge
Integrity attestation determinism test (same window → same checksum)
Calibration drift detector unit + replay tests on synthetic drift
Read-only API test: all observatory endpoints reject writes (405)
Ground-truth plan coverage computation property tests
Anomaly hunter shadow-mode test: no outbound side-effects, no prod writes
EffectivenessReport statistical sanity (delta bounds, confidence sane)
UX event consent gating test: events without consent_flag rejected
Retention/lifecycle test: telemetry expires per policy
PREPROD_ONLY guard test: production env fails fast on bootstrap
security: Read-only RBAC for observatory roles; least-privilege service accounts
Hashed session/driver identifiers in UX signals; no PII in telemetry
Tamper-evident checksums for metric integrity; append-only store
Secrets for detector/model refs via existing secret manager
Preprod-only namespace enforced via config guard at startup
Audit log for governance approvals and calibration changes
observability: Observatory self-metrics: registry size, lineage edge count, attestation latency
Calibration drift alarms with runbook links
Read-only API error rate and latency SLOs
rollback: Feature flags per batch (registry, calibration, lineage, integrity, planner, hunter, effectiveness, ux)
Shadow mode default for unknown-unknown hunter; disable flag reverts to no emission
Contract versions additive; deprecate via version bump not deletion
Append-only stores; rollback = disable writers + retain data
Per-batch migration scripts with documented down path
distillation_targets: Lineage capture wrapper usage guide for engineers

raw_model_human_required: Approve metric definitions and governance/approval policy ownership, since metric semantics and sign-off authority cannot be safely inferred or auto-assigned.
